Dual-Wavelength Precision

Blacken X introduces dual melanin absorption peaks at 532nm and 755nm, compared to the single-band system of Blacken Pro. This enhanced spectral range enables deeper, more comprehensive treatment of superficial, dermal, and latent pigmentation—tackling existing spots while preventing future ones.

True Clinical Power at Home

Upgraded power system delivers 100% of professional-grade fluence, with In-Motion 3Hz pulse technology for continuous high-energy output. This results in faster, more visible fading of stubborn, large pigmented lesions, with improved comfort and uniformity.

Advanced Sapphire Cooling

Equipped with a 4.5cm² full-screen sapphire contact surface, Blacken X cools down to 4.2°C in just 60 seconds—three times the cooling efficiency of traditional devices. This ensures a painless experience by minimizing redness, burning, and post-treatment sensitivity.

3 Pro Modes, Targeted Results

With upgraded FAST GLOW, SPOT+, and REDNESS+ modes, Blacken X adapts to individual needs—whether for brightening dull tone, fading hyperpigmentation, or calming redness. Optimized pulse durations and energy densities ensure quick and targeted results, especially for melanin-rich or sensitive skin types.

Redness Relief with Green Light

Unlike Blacken Pro, Blacken X integrates 540nm green light to precisely act on dilated capillaries and reduce erythema. This wavelength is selectively absorbed by hemoglobin, triggering vasoconstriction and significantly improving facial redness and rosacea-prone skin over time.

DPL Precision Narrow-Spectrum Technology

Targets and Improves Melanin Deposits and Capillary Expansion Issues

DPL Precise Narrow Spectrum

The wave band is 500-650nm, which is the absorption peak of melanin and oxygenated hemoglobinThe absorption rate of precise narrow spectrum melanin is twice that of traditional photons, and the absorption rate of hemoglobin is 3x that of traditional photons.

Sapphire Cooling Surface Area

Light waves act on the dermis of the skin and generate heat that positively affects the circulation Sapphire-based technology can protect the skin surface and prevent heat damage.

More Effective and Safe

· With the advantage of its low-influence and high-density energy and speed, D-light is considered the most effective and safe when treating skin conditions.

· DPL can treat Rosacea-related facial problems such as redness, spider veins, pigmentation, and spots. It also has an anti-aging effect and can make your skin brighter and reduce pigmentation.

At-home Photofacial Skincare

The world's first at-home DPL facial treatment skincare device and we redefine Pro.

Frequently Asked Questions

Have questions? We’re here to help

Q1: Any preparation before the treatment?

① Clean your face; use a hydration mist spray if your skin feels dry
② If you have been exposed heavily to the sun in the last 3 days, we do not recommend you to use it
③ Test the device on the inner part of your arm, and check for any reaction after 1 hour. If any reaction occurs, do not use the device

Q2: What should I be aware of after the treatment?

①Use a cooling mask to calm the skin
②Do not wash your face with hot water
③Avoid sun for a minimum of 48 hours
④Avoid all special-purposed skin care products

Q3: What type of people are not suitable for this device?

Under 16 years of age, women during pregrancy, lactation, menstruation, people with scars, people with sensitive skin

Q4: How to take care of the device?

Use a cotton pad with a 75% alcohol solution for cleaning

Q5: What are the major pros of having an at-home laser device versus going
into a clinic?

More affordable: Long-term use higher cost performance and the same DPL Technology as a beauty salon
Easy and convenient: 2-3 times a week at home
